analysis.title: Clean Flash: BE Project Jupiter, ENPH SST, SEDG, Recent IPO Performance
key_insights: Bloom Energy (BE): Project Jupiter, Oracle's data center in Las Cruces, New Mexico, depends on an air permit from the New Mexico Environment Department. The hearing officer rejected New Energy Economy's Motion to Dismiss on Oct 26, leaving the Dec 7 merits hearing on schedule. An opinion is expected by year-end 2026, though the timeline could extend.

Project Jupiter revised its application: fuel-cell stacks cut to 1,263 from 2,275, stack height raised to 45 ft from 30 ft, in 197 pages of revisions and new modeling. Opponents say more accurate facility data roughly doubled modeled pollutant concentrations. NMED has given no completion date for its technical review of the Oct 16 revised application.

Timing matters for Project Jupiter because a favorable ruling before the new governor takes office would let the current Environmental Improvement Board likely deny any appeal. An opinion in January 2027 or later would let the incoming governor influence the board and NMED leadership, adding uncertainty.

Haaland (D), the likely governor-elect, has committed to a data center moratorium on day one but said she 'can't stop Project Jupiter.' Jefferies is increasingly less concerned about the incoming administration for this project, citing labor support and the nearly complete facility.

The Green Chili natural gas pipeline cannot start substantive work until the air permit clears. The incoming Land Commissioner is expected to open negotiations with Oracle in Q1 2027. FERC approval is expected in December. Jefferies does not see the pipeline as the principal gating item.

Water rights are viewed as legally well-settled and not a material risk. The $165Bn Dona Ana County industrial revenue bonds face a retroactive claw-back threat from Senator Cervantes, which would change project economics but not stop the project.

Oracle approached El Paso Electric for backup power covering about 1/4 of the data center's needs. A materially larger external grid share could conflict with the IRB terms tied to on-site generation and require a new IRB.

New Mexico's 2027 legislative session is expected to favor a guardrail bill over an outright data center moratorium. Whether grandfathering covers in-flight projects like Jupiter is an open question. Project Jupiter would deploy over 2 GW of fuel cells once fully operational.

Enphase (ENPH) and Infineon announced a 900 V monolithic GaN bidirectional switch, being integrated into IQ SST development builds. It allows fewer series-connected modules, a unipolar 800 VDC output and a path to 1,500 VDC, which ENPH believes enables a single-stage SST architecture.

Jefferies calls the NVIDIA/Infineon GaN work incremental validation only, since NVIDIA uses GaN at the high-voltage intermediate bus converter stage, not across the full power architecture. The 900 V devices have not completed production qualification, so commercialization is the main open question.

SolarEdge (SEDG): Israeli outlet Globes reports about 200 layoffs and the company has not commented. Jefferies calls it incrementally more concerning given the timing before 3Q earnings and after the September Analyst Day, and says it has been cautious on residential broadly.

Recent power, energy and infrastructure IPOs are down about 40.5% on average and 41.0% at the median from IPO price, and about 30.3% market-cap weighted. Excluding nuclear, the cohort is down about 23.8% on average and 15.1% at the median.

Nuclear and advanced nuclear IPOs are the weakest: Fermi about -87.9%, Deep Fission about -85.6%, X-Energy about -53.9%, Hadron Energy about -92.5%. Legence (LGN) is the only clear outlier, up about 28.8% from its $28 IPO price. Cumulative nuclear market cap continues to decline y/y and sequentially.
Forgent (FPS) fell below its IPO price for the first time after a CEO departure, and is down about 10.3% from IPO.

market_movers.rationale: Air permit approval for Project Jupiter is increasingly consensus but remains an important catalyst. Slipping into 2027 would extend the near-term overhang on Bloom.
The 900 V GaN switch strengthens technical differentiation in SST, but production qualification and commercialization are still pending.
Reported layoffs of about 200 employees ahead of 3Q earnings. Jefferies has been cautious on residential solar broadly.
The only clear positive IPO performer, up about 28.8% from its IPO price of $28, at $36.07.
The CEO departure pushed the stock below its IPO price for the first time. It is down about 10.3% from IPO.
X-Energy is down about 53.9% from its $23 IPO price, part of the severe nuclear IPO underperformance.

sector_views.rationale: Jefferies says it has been cautious on residential broadly, and new SEDG layoffs are incrementally more concerning.
Investors are skeptical of long-dated, capital-intensive technologies with uncertain commercialization, and IPOs in the group are down more than 50% in several cases.

earnings_insights: SEDG 3Q earnings report is upcoming, with the date not given. Jefferies flags the layoff reports as more concerning given the timing before it and after the September Analyst Day.
risk_factors: Air permit hearing could be delayed if NMED requests a schedule change or the revised application extends the review.
An appeal to the Environmental Improvement Board is likely from opponents, and the board's composition could change if the ruling slips into January 2027 or later.
The incoming governor appoints NMED leadership, and the NMED Cabinet Secretary has final authority to sign off on, modify or deny the permit.
Retroactive claw-back of the $165Bn industrial revenue bonds, and the legal and economic uncertainty of external power supply arrangements.
A 2027 New Mexico data center moratorium or guardrail bill without grandfathering for in-flight projects.
ENPH's 900 V GaN devices have not completed production qualification, and system-level pilot performance, efficiency, reliability and customer validation remain unproven.
SEDG layoffs ahead of 3Q earnings could signal weakness in residential demand.

The Dec 7 air permit hearing at NMED and the 2027 legislative session, with moratorium versus guardrail bills and possible grandfathering for in-flight data center projects.

tension_points.bull_case: The Motion to Dismiss was denied, the Dec 7 hearing is on track, a respected hearing officer makes appeals harder to sustain, and labor and economic support could carry the project under a new administration.
tension_points.bear_case: NMED has given no completion date for its technical review, the revised application could extend the timeline, and a ruling in January 2027 or later would let the incoming governor influence the appeal board and NMED leadership.
tension_points.what_invalidates: An opinion slipping to January 2027 or later, or NMED requesting a change to the Dec 7 hearing date.

tension_points.bull_case: The 900 V GaN switch simplifies the SST architecture, with fewer modules and a path to 800 VDC and 1,500 VDC, and Infineon's NVIDIA work adds ecosystem validation.
tension_points.bear_case: The devices have not completed production qualification, and NVIDIA uses GaN only at the intermediate bus converter stage, not the full architecture.
tension_points.what_invalidates: System-level pilot performance, efficiency, reliability or customer validation falling short of the next SST milestones.
